prompt: Review the feature list in backlog for potential duplicates

result.summary: No duplicate features found in the backlog. The 68 features are well-organized with clear separation of concerns. Features that might appear similar at first glance (like content-entry-delete vs content-soft-delete, or the various reference field types) actually serve distinct purposes and have appropriate dependency relationships. The backlog demonstrates good architectural planning with features properly scoped to single responsibilities.
